$comment: Types the engine reaches through reflective/generic adapters (type names never appear literally in the source, so the lexical audit cannot see them). Each entry names the tool, how it reaches the type and the real-project evidence. Audit-OpennessCoverage.ps1 reports matching UNTOUCHED / TYPE_NAMED_NO_MEMBER types as DYNAMIC. Patterns match the full type name; * is a wildcard.

entries.mechanism: Create<T>(name) by resolved CLR type; properties read/written by reflection (scalar, Color, parts, MultilingualText)
Create<T>(name) by resolved CLR type; properties read/written by reflection (scalar, Color, parts, MultilingualText)
Create<T>(name[, containedType]); properties by reflection; view/column/trend parts via ManageUnifiedObjectParts
base-class properties of every screen item (Left/Top/Width/Height, Visible, Enabled, TabIndex, Authorization, Opacity, ToolTipText, rotation, LinearMovement part)
feature interfaces reported per item type; their members are the item properties above
native EventHandlers.Create(enum) per composition; script fields by reflection
composition Create()/Create(string), nested part properties by reflection
